ratios.quote: Our leverage ratio was 4.2 to 1.00 as of the end of the third quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to 4.4 to 1.00 as of the end of fiscal 2025.
Our leverage ratio was 4.2 to 1.00 as of the end of the third quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to 4.4 to 1.00 as of the end of fiscal 2025.

parsed.notes: Leverage ratio is Total Indebtedness (incl. finance leases) minus unrestricted cash over 2023 Facility Adjusted EBITDA; the covenant requires it to be less than 5.00x through March 2028. The 5.00x limit at 2025-12-28 is inferred from the statement that it applies through maturity. The 3.00x restricted-payments threshold and the interest margin grid (3.00x/4.00x) are excluded because they are not maintenance covenants.
